📉 What moved today, Thursday 12 November

🪙 Gold fell about 3% to around $3,865 an ounce, below $4,000, as the US dollar hit a 19-month high. Traders are betting the US central bank could raise interest rates.

🇿🇦 The JSE Top 40 closed 0.6% lower at 104,981. Mining shares fell 2.3%, while banks and insurers rose 0.4%.

💱 The rand weakened about 1% to around R16.76 to the dollar. Brent oil rose 0.8% to about $93.51.

What it means for you: a weaker rand and dearer oil can make fuel and imported goods more expensive.

Prices are 15-minute delayed. Education, not financial advice.
